chapter: Metronome, Billie Holiday, Cleveland and Atlantic
title: Billie's lateness and the fine from Bobby Haggart
summary: He was fined when snow made him bring Billie late to a session.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Oh yeah I know her very good.
Did you play with her much? Did she come to jam sessions where you were?

Well, there wasn't no jam sessions, we were just workin' together... I had some pictures I gave to some girl who was writin' a book -- I never got the pictures, a book or nothin'. One picture I had that showed...
What was it like playing with Billie?
It was a problem, not with her singin' or nothin', but with her bein' on time, you know.

That was her only problem. I got a fine one time -- pickin' her up to carry her to one of the sessions -- recording sessions. And they fined me. Johnny Haggart -- bass player -- Bobby Haggart -- he was the leader of the band. the

know I couldn't read you know. But I think he took it out on me, just for bein' there, but I didn't ask to be there -- she asked me to be there. So, we were late. It was showin' though -- snow was knee-deep. We were very much late gettin' there. Held up the thing over an hour or and hour and a half or so -- for a hour session. So it made them go over time. So he named me as the culprit, as you might say. He didn't have to do it. You know, I wasn't the leader, I was just there. I don't know if he fined her or not, because she wasn't a musician. So he took it out on me -- that's what it was. She wasn't in the union. I don't know if she was even in the guild at that time. He couldn't do nothin' to her. He sure took it out on me...
